title: Aikatsu Pripara THE MOVIE -Miraculous Meeting!- (2026)

title_lang.zh_hk: 星夢學園×星光樂園 THE MOVIE -相遇的奇蹟！- (2026)

synopsis:
Akari Ōzora(Aikatsu) and Laala Manaka(Pripara), two idols shining in their own worlds, suddenly find themselves sharing the same stage!


In a miraculous encounter between "Aikatsu!" and "Pripara," two worlds that were never meant to cross paths! The idols from Starlight Academy(Aikatsu) and Parajuku(Pripara) are enjoying a dream collaboration at a joint live festival, but before they know it, something terrible is happening in the outside world…!?


Get ready for the ultimate stage filled with excitement and sparkle at Broadway Cinemas only! Here begins the idol performance where everyone is friends, and everyone is an idol!

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
《星夢學園×星光樂園 THE MOVIE -相遇的奇蹟！-》即將獨家登陸百老匯院線! 
大空明里與真中菈菈，兩位在各自世界中閃耀光芒的偶像，竟然不可思議地突然站上了同一個舞台！

 

《星夢學園》與《星光樂園》，原本不可能交會的兩個世界，迎來了奇蹟般的相遇！星夢學園與星元宿的偶像們，在聯合演唱會上享受著夢幻般的合作演出，然而就在不知不覺間，外面的世界似乎發生了不得了的大事件……!?
充滿期待與閃耀光芒的最棒舞台即將開幕！大家都是朋友，大家都是偶像！一場前所未有的偶像活動，就此展開！
